page_title: ANG 4-1 NAN | Angers v Nantes 12/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' 4 - 1 Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Anthony Lopes with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 4:1.
90+1' The manager makes a subsitution with Florent Hanin (Angers) coming on for Himad Abdelli.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' It will be a corner kick for Nantes.
90' Junior Mwanga (Nantes) smashes the ball towards the top right corner of the goal, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant reflex save.
87' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Stephanie Frappart signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Angers players celebrate.
86' The Angers players joy may have been justified, because referee Stephanie Frappart is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
85' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Harouna Djibirin (Angers) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
85' Angers earn a corner.
85' Harouna Djibirin (Angers) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Angers will take a corner.
82' A substitution has been made. Deiver Machado is replaced by Amady Camara (Nantes).
82' The substitution has been made. Bahmed Deuff (Nantes) has replaced Johann Lepenant.
82' Here is a change. Louis Mouton is going off and Alexandre Dujeux gives the last tactical orders to Marius Courcoul (Angers).
82' Substitution. Amine Sbai makes way for Harouna Djibirin (Angers).
82' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to substitute Yassine Belkhdim and he is replaced by Lilian Raolisoa (Angers).
81' 2 - 1 Fabien Centonze (Nantes) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb into the top right corner. What a perfect shot.
80' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
79' Himad Abdelli (Angers) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
78' Angers failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

77' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the right post, but Anthony Lopes has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. Angers win a corner kick.
77' Total attempts – 15:3.
75' Matthis Abline (Nantes) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
73' It is time for a substitution. Prosper Peter (Angers) is on for Sidiki Cherif.
72' Angers take a short corner kick.
72' Amine Sbai (Angers) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

71' Himad Abdelli (Angers) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Anthony Lopes was alert and made an astonishing save! The ball is out of play and Angers manage to earn a corner.
70' Looks like Louis Mouton (Angers) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
69' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
66' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
64' Ahmed Kantari has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mayckel Lahdo (Nantes) replacing Yassine Benhattab.
64' The game has come to an end for Mostafa Mohamed. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Youssef El Arabi (Nantes).

64' Himad Abdelli (Angers) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
64' Amine Sbai (Angers) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
63' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. The ball is out of play. Angers will have a chance to score from a corner.
60' 2 - 0 Goal! Louis Mouton puts the ball on a plate for Sidiki Cherif (Angers), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 2:0.
60' Matthis Abline (Nantes) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
58' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
53' Louis Mouton (Angers) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
53' Good defending. Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) tries to find Louis Mouton inside the box, but the pass is cut out. Angers have a corner.
52' Nantes hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
48' Louis Mouton (Angers) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Stephanie Frappart saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Nantes, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Fabien Centonze (Nantes) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
40' Nantes fail to score from a corner as Herve Koffi (Angers) leaps to collect the ball.
39' It looked like the long-range shot by Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.

37' Wasted opportunity! Haris Belkebla (Angers) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.

35' That didn't go as planned! Amine Sbai (Angers) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Anthony Lopes, who easily kept it out.
33' Carlens Arcus (Angers) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Nantes.

27' Yassine Benhattab (Nantes) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Herve Koffi pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
24' Matthis Abline (Nantes) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
23' Nantes win a corner.
17' 1 - 0 Goal! Himad Abdelli (Angers) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Anthony Lopes into the top left corner.
17' Himad Abdelli (Angers) is going to take the penalty!
16' It’s a PENALTY to Angers after the VAR review!
14' Referee Stephanie Frappart makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Angers. Let’s see what happens!
13' Surely that's handball by one of the Nantes players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

13' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. The ball goes out of play. Angers are awarded a corner kick.
11' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Yassine Benhattab (Nantes), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
11' Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul after Jordan Lefort (Angers) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Free kick. Nantes will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
9' A shot from the edge of the box by Louis Mouton (Angers) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
8' Some neat passing and movement from Angers as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
6' Carlens Arcus (Angers) commits a foul and Stephanie Frappart immediately signals a free kick.
5' A long ball forward to Sidiki Cherif (Angers) is intercepted.
1' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) is caught offside!
1' The first half has started.
Angers will kick the game off.
Stephanie Frappart is introduced as the referee for today's match.
